description: This source file defines the `TypescriptParserFacade` class, which implements the `ITypescriptParser` interface. It provides methods to parse TypeScript class definitions from source code, extract variables, and serialize class definitions back to source code. The facade simplifies access to parsing and serialization functionalities within the project.

classes.name: TypescriptParserFacade
classes.description: A facade class providing simplified access to TypeScript parsing, variable extraction, and serialization functionalities.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses TypeScript source code to produce a ClassDefinition object.

methods.name: Variables
methods.description: Extracts variables from TypeScript source code into a list of VariableDefinition objects.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Serializes a ClassDefinition object back into its source code representation.
